requirements.normative_requirement: Host/daemon/agent control frames use a versioned length-framed Protocol Buffers schema with strict size limits.
requirements.primary_verification: Coverage-guided protobuf/framing fuzzing and oversize corpus.

requirements.normative_requirement: Every call uses a UUIDv7 identity unique across sessions and restarts; duplicate identities cannot execute twice.
requirements.primary_verification: Replay same ID before, during, and after terminal state.

requirements.normative_requirement: D1 call admission is durably committed before execution starts; D0 read admission may remain volatile only when read-only enforcement is mechanically proven.
requirements.primary_verification: Crash at each admission transaction boundary.

requirements.normative_requirement: Streaming uses monotonic sequence numbers, bounded chunks, bounded credits, and bounded daemon memory.
requirements.primary_verification: Slow/no-reading client, huge stdout/stderr, chunk reorder/duplicate tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: Cancellation and terminal completion have specified durable linearization points; uncertainty is returned as unknown.
requirements.primary_verification: Race cancellation against exit and terminal DB commit under fault injection.

requirements.normative_requirement: The user-scoped Unix socket authenticates clients with filesystem permissions and SO_PEERCRED.
requirements.primary_verification: Wrong UID, stale socket, symlinked socket, and forged session-registration attempts.

requirements.normative_requirement: Reconnect and daemon restart never replay an already accepted effectful call.
requirements.primary_verification: Disconnect/reconnect at every call state and verify state lookup instead of rerun.
